name: angular-to-react
description: Migrate Angular (2+) and AngularJS (1.x) apps to React — full rewrites or incremental strangler-fig migrations of any size, including hybrid ngUpgrade apps.

interface.longDescription: Migrate Angular (2+) and AngularJS (1.x) apps to React — full rewrites or incremental strangler-fig migrations of any size, including hybrid ngUpgrade apps. Keeps resumable migration state in .migration/, inventories the app before changing code, and checks each migrated piece for parity with the original.
defaultPrompt: Plan a migration of this Angular app to React
